items.title: Section: The Benefits of Purification — Realising Great Nirvana, Inconceivable in Five Ways

items.zh: 菩薩依此四如實智，能正了知八種分別；於現法中正了知故，令當來世戲論所攝所依緣事不復生起；不生起故，於當來世從彼依緣所起分別亦不復生。
items.en: Resting on these four kinds of true wisdom, bodhisattvas are able to correctly understand the eight kinds of discrimination. Because they correctly understand this in the present, the basis and object belonging to conceptual proliferation no longer arise in future lives; and because these no longer arise, the discrimination that would arise resting on that basis and object in future lives no longer arises either.

items.zh: 如是分別及依緣事二俱滅故，當知一切戲論皆滅；菩薩如是戲論滅故，能證大乘大般涅槃。
items.en: Because discrimination and its basis and object are thus both extinguished, it should be understood that all conceptual proliferation is extinguished. Because a bodhisattva's conceptual proliferation is thus extinguished, they are able to realise the Great Vehicle's own great nirvāṇa.

items.title: Section: Ten Kinds of Mastery Attained at the Eighth Ground

items.zh: 於現法中，勝真實義所行處智極清淨故，普能獲得一切自在。
items.en: In this very life, because the wisdom operating within the domain of supreme true reality has become utterly pure, one universally attains every kind of mastery.

items.zh: 謂諸菩薩於種種化，獲得能化神通自在；於種種變，獲得能變神通自在。
items.en: Bodhisattvas attain mastery of the miraculous power to conjure a variety of created things, and attain mastery of the miraculous power to transform a variety of existing things into other things.

items.title: Mastery Over Knowledge, Teaching, and One's Own Lifespan

items.zh: 普於一切所知境智，皆得自在。若欲久住，隨其所樂自在能住；若欲終歿，不待害緣，自在能歿。
items.en: They attain mastery universally over every object of knowledge and the wisdom knowing it. If they wish to remain long in the world, they are able, as they please, to remain at will; if they wish to pass away, they are able to pass away at will, without needing to rely on any harmful condition.

items.zh: 由諸菩薩得如是等無量自在，於諸有情最勝無上。
items.en: Because bodhisattvas attain immeasurable mastery such as this, they are the most excellent and unsurpassed among all sentient beings.

items.title: Section: Five Supreme Benefits — Stillness, Mastery of Knowledge, Tirelessness, Insight into Hidden Intent, and Unshakeable Conviction

items.zh: 菩薩如是普於一切得自在故，獲得五種最上勝利。一者、獲得心極寂靜。由住最靜故，不由煩惱寂靜故。二者、能於一切明處無所罣礙，清淨鮮白妙智見轉。三者、為利諸有情故，流轉生死無有厭倦。
items.en: Because bodhisattvas thus attain universal mastery over all things, they attain five supreme benefits. First, they attain the utmost stillness of mind. Second, they are unobstructed with respect to every field of knowledge, with pure, luminous, and wondrous wisdom and insight operating freely. Third, for the sake of benefiting sentient beings, they cycle through birth-and-death without any weariness.

items.zh: 四者、善入一切如來密意言義。五者、所得大乘勝解不可引奪、不從他緣。
items.en: Fourth, they skilfully enter into the hidden intent behind everything the Tathāgata has spoken. Fifth, the conviction they have gained in the Great Vehicle cannot be seized away by others, and does not depend on external conditions.

items.zh: 當知如是五種勝利，有五種業。一者、菩薩成就最勝現法樂住，能滅一切為趣菩提精勤加行所生身心種種勞倦。當知是名心極寂靜勝利之業。二者、菩薩普能成熟一切佛法。當知是名於諸明處無礙清白微妙智見勝利之業。三者、菩薩普能成熟一切有情。當知是名流轉生死無有厭倦勝利之業。四者、

items.title: Section: Protecting the True Teaching — Genuine Dharma Versus Its Counterfeit

items.zh: 菩薩能正除遣所化有情隨所生起一切疑惑；護持如來妙正法眼，令得久住；於能隱沒如來聖教像似正法，能知、能顯、能正除滅。
items.en: Bodhisattvas are able to correctly dispel every doubt that arises in the beings they are guiding; they uphold the Tathāgata's wondrous, true Dharma-eye, causing it to endure long in the world; and with respect to counterfeit teachings capable of obscuring the Tathāgata's true doctrine, they are able to recognise them, expose them, and correctly eliminate them.

items.zh: 當知是名善入如來密意言義

items.title: The Five Benefits' Practical Functions — And the Bodhisattva's Unshakeable Vows

items.zh: 勝利之業。五者、菩薩能摧一切外道異論，精進堅牢，正願無動。
items.en: First, bodhisattvas accomplish the most excellent abiding in present bliss, able to dissolve every kind of bodily and mental fatigue produced by diligent effort towards awakening ... Fifth, bodhisattvas are able to crush every rival doctrine of other paths, their diligence firm and unbreakable, their genuine vows unmoving.

items.zh: 當知是名大乘勝解不可引奪、不從他緣勝利之業。
如是菩薩所有一切菩薩所作，皆為如是五勝利業之所攝受。云何一切菩薩所作？謂自安樂而無雜染，普能成熟一切佛法，普能成熟一切有情，護持如來無上正法，摧伏他論、精進勇猛、正願無動。
items.en: Thus, every activity a bodhisattva undertakes is encompassed within these five beneficial functions. What constitutes the entirety of a bodhisattva's activity? It is: abiding in one's own ease free of defilement; universally maturing all buddha-dharmas; universally maturing all sentient beings; upholding the Tathāgata's unsurpassed true teaching; and crushing rival doctrines through vigorous diligence and unwavering, genuine vows.

items.title: Section: Fascicle 36 Complete — Ranking the Four Truths, Closing the Entire Chapter on True Meaning

items.zh: 當知如是四真實義，初二下劣，第三處中，第四最勝。
items.en: It should be understood that, among these four truths, the first two are inferior, the third occupies the middle, and the fourth is supreme.

blocks.text: The fruit of this understanding, and the close of the chapter on true meaning. A short passage (0491a13) is untranslated.

"Resting on these four true wisdoms, bodhisattvas correctly understand the eight discriminations." The basis of proliferation no longer arises in future lives; "discrimination and its basis are extinguished, and all conceptual proliferation is extinguished". So "they realise the Great Vehicle's own great nirvāṇa".

"Because wisdom in the domain of supreme reality has become utterly pure, one attains every kind of mastery": to conjure and to transform; over every object of knowledge; over one's lifespan ("if they wish to pass away, they can, without relying on any harmful condition").

"The utmost stillness of mind"; "unobstructed wisdom regarding every field of knowledge"; tirelessness in benefiting beings; "skilfully entering the hidden intent behind everything the Tathāgata has spoken"; and conviction in the Great Vehicle "that cannot be seized away by others".
They dispel beings' doubts, "uphold the Tathāgata's true Dharma-eye", and expose counterfeit teachings.
"Among these four truths, the first two are inferior, the third middle, the fourth supreme."

This fascicle holds the treatise's central teaching on reality: the middle way between existence and non-existence, the inexpressible nature, correct and incorrect emptiness, and the four investigations. It is worth rereading. Fascicle 37 continues the Bodhisattva Stage with the chapter on power.

quiz.q: "Because conceptual proliferation is extinguished, the bodhisattva realises the Great Vehicle's great nirvāṇa." What do the masters say?
options: Miào Jìng: conception is proliferation, so "inconceivable" is its extinction; Cháng Bǎi: one realises the Mahāyāna's non-abiding great nirvāṇa
quiz.why: "Because a bodhisattva's conceptual proliferation is thus extinguished, they are able to realise the Great Vehicle's own great nirvāṇa." Venerable Miào Jìng: conceiving is proliferation; "inconceivable" now means proliferation extinguished. Master Cháng Bǎi: one can realise the Mahāyāna's non-abiding great nirvāṇa.

quiz.q: "If they wish to pass away, they can at will." In Master Cháng Bǎi's story of Páng Yùn's family, who passed away last?
quiz.why: "If they wish to pass away, they are able to pass away at will, without needing to rely on any harmful condition." Master Cháng Bǎi: in the end, Layman Páng Yùn passed away seated last of all. (The daughter went first, then the wife; the note's order is wrong.)

quiz.q: The first benefit: "the utmost stillness of mind." What stillness does Venerable Miào Jìng mean?
options: abiding in utmost stillness — attaining concentration, whose power is stillest
quiz.why: "First, they attain the utmost stillness of mind." Venerable Miào Jìng: it belongs to abiding in utmost stillness — attaining concentration, whose power is stillest. (The treatise adds: by abiding in utmost stillness, not by stilling afflictions.)

quiz.q: "Among the four realities, the first two are inferior." Why, per Master Cháng Bǎi?
options: world-established and reason-established truth are shared with the world — so inferior
quiz.why: "Among these four truths, the first two are inferior, the third occupies the middle, and the fourth is supreme." Master Cháng Bǎi: world-established truth and reason-established truth are both shared with the world — relatively inferior.
